function.name: updateDOMListeners
function.description: This function updates the DOM event listeners from an old virtual node to a new one, ensuring that any changes in event listeners are properly handled and applied to the target element. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

oldVnode.description: The old virtual node, containing data about previous event listeners. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

vnode.description: The new virtual node, containing data about current event listeners. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

2. Remove any listeners that no longer exist.  
3. Add or update listeners that are new or changed.  
4. For the `click` event on the new node, it will normalize the handler (e.g., wrap it in a function that ensures the correct `this` context, prevents default if needed, etc.) before attaching it.
